items.definition:
relating to the science or practice of building or flying aircraft
She is studying aeronautical engineering.

without foundation in fact
The accusations were completely baseless.

without doubt; certainly
He will doubtless succeed with his determination.

showing or giving emphasis; expressing something forcibly and clearly
She gave an emphatic nod of agreement.

not logical or reasonable
His argument was completely illogical.

expressed in an incomprehensible or confusing way
After the accident, he was incoherent.

easily annoyed or angered
He was feeling irritable after a sleepless night.

Moderately warm; unenthusiastic.
The tea was lukewarm, not hot enough.

giving pleasure
It was a truly pleasurable experience.

having doubts or reservations
She remained skeptical about his claims.

showing symptoms of a disease; indicative of something undesirable
His cough was symptomatic of a cold.

watching carefully; alert and vigilant
The cat was watchful as the mouse scurried across the floor.

malicious or unpleasant
Her bitchy comments upset everyone.

polite and well-mannered; developed and advanced
They live in a civilized society with laws and order.

dull, bleak, and depressing
The weather was dreary and rainy all day.

Providing a remedy, especially for a deficiency or difficulty.
He needed remedial classes to improve his math skills.

able to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties
She is a very resourceful person, always finding solutions to problems.

relating to or involving sacrifice
The team made a sacrificial effort to win the game.

causing one to feel tired or bored
The long meeting was quite tiresome.

not able to be mistaken or misunderstood
The smell of freshly baked bread was unmistakable.

disorderly and difficult to control
The teacher struggled to manage the unruly class.

secreting venom; poisonous
Be careful, some snakes are venomous.

having or showing a stubborn determination to do as one pleases
Her willful disobedience led to consequences.

delicately small and pretty
She wore a dainty silver necklace.

without money, food, a home, or possessions
The war left many families destitute.

lively, determined, and courageous
She's a feisty old woman who isn't afraid to speak her mind.

quick and light in movement or action
He was nimble enough to dodge the falling debris.

causing disapproval or offense
His comments were highly objectionable.

able to be obtained

situated far from a center
They visited the outlying villages during their trip.

of poor quality; worthless
I don't like watching trashy reality TV shows.

not loyal or trustworthy
She felt betrayed after discovering her partner had been unfaithful.

not subject to regulation or control

able to live both on land and in water
Frogs are amphibious creatures.

having a strong dislike or opposition to something

expressing praise or celebration
They had a celebratory dinner after the graduation.

having the property of conducting heat or electricity
Copper is a highly conductive metal.

relating to a curriculum
The school is reviewing its extracurricular and curricular activities.

showy, ostentatious

grown or produced in one's own garden or country
We enjoyed the delicious homegrown tomatoes from our garden.

able to be sold or marketed

not involving violence

determined, feisty, or aggressive; consisting of or characterized by scraps.

able to be transferred or moved from one place, person, or thing to another.

The building had an interesting asymmetrical design.

prejudiced, intolerant

without defense; vulnerable

demanding something forcefully; persistent

(of something provided or available) lacking in quantity or quality

quick to notice things

dark or dull in color or tone; gloomy

without being announced or expected

not divided or broken into parts; complete and continuous

not written down or recorded; understood or established by custom
There's an unwritten rule that you don't talk during the movie.

relating to plants or botany
The botanic garden has a wide variety of plant species.

able to be detected or discovered
There was no detectable trace of the chemical.
